```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. DATA LOAD & COMPREHENSIVE CLEANING
# ==============================================================================
full_model_data <- read.csv("full_model_data.csv")

analysis_df <- full_model_data %>%
  mutate(
    # ===========================================================================
    # DEMOGRAPHICS
    # ===========================================================================
    age_group = if_else(age_group < 0, NA_real_, age_group),
    age_group = factor(age_group,
                       levels = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
                       labels = c("10-19", "20-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70+")),
    
    sex = if_else(sex < 0, NA_real_, sex),
    sex = as.factor(sex),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # MENTAL HEALTH (GHQ)
    # ===========================================================================
    GHQ_score = if_else(GHQ_score < 0, NA_real_, GHQ_score),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # HEALTH & FINANCES
    # ===========================================================================
    sf12pcs = if_else(sf12pcs < 0, NA_real_, sf12pcs),
    financial_status = if_else(financial_status < 0, NA_real_, financial_status),
    
    # FIXED: Add factor version of financial status for models
    financial_status_f = factor(
      financial_status,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c("Living comfortably", "Doing alright", 
                 "Just getting by", "Finding it difficult", 
                 "Very difficult")
    ),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # EDUCATION
    # ===========================================================================
    education_level = if_else(education_level < 0, NA_real_, education_level),
    education = case_when(
      education_level %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Higher ed",
      education_level %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Secondary",
      education_level %in% c(5, 9) ~ "Other/None",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # FIXED:  Consistent factor level order (Other/None as reference)
    education = factor(education, 
                       levels = c("Other/None", "Secondary", "Higher ed")),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # SOCIAL SUPPORT (POSITIVE)
    # ===========================================================================
    positive_friend_ss = if_else(positive_friend_ss < 0, NA_real_, positive_friend_ss),
    positive_family_ss = if_else(positive_family_ss < 0, NA_real_, positive_family_ss),
    positive_spouse_ss = if_else(positive_spouse_ss < 0, NA_real_, positive_spouse_ss),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # SOCIAL STRAIN (NEGATIVE)
    # ===========================================================================
    negative_friend_ss = if_else(negative_friend_ss < 0, NA_real_, negative_friend_ss),
    negative_family_ss = if_else(negative_family_ss < 0, NA_real_, negative_family_ss),
    negative_spouse_ss = if_else(negative_spouse_ss < 0, NA_real_, negative_spouse_ss),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # PARTNER STATUS
    # ===========================================================================
    live_w_partner = if_else(live_w_partner < 0, NA_real_, live_w_partner),
    live_w_spouse = if_else(live_w_spouse < 0, NA_real_, live_w_spouse),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # LIFESTYLE - SLEEP
    # ===========================================================================
    sleep_hrs = if_else(sleep_hrs < 0, NA_real_, sleep_hrs),
    sleep_mins = if_else(sleep_mins < 0, NA_real_, sleep_mins),
    total_sleep_hours = sleep_hrs + (sleep_mins / 60),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # LIFESTYLE - DIET
    # ===========================================================================
    weekly_fruit = if_else(weekly_fruit < 0, NA_real_, weekly_fruit),
    weekly_veggies = if_else(weekly_veggies < 0, NA_real_, weekly_veggies),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # LIFESTYLE - EXERCISE
    # ===========================================================================
    weekly_walked = if_else(weekly_walked < 0, NA_real_, weekly_walked),
    weekly_m_exercised = if_else(weekly_m_exercised < 0, NA_real_, weekly_m_exercised),
    weekly_v_exercised = if_else(weekly_v_exercised < 0, NA_real_, weekly_v_exercised),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # SOCIAL MEDIA (Dropped from models but clean anyway)
    # ===========================================================================
    sm_post_freq = if_else(sm_post_freq < 0, NA_real_, sm_post_freq),
    sm_look_freq = if_else(sm_look_freq < 0, NA_real_, sm_look_freq),
    
    # ===========================================================================
    # WAVE HANDLING
    # ===========================================================================
    wave = as.factor(wave)
  )

# Verify cleaning worked
cat("=== POST-CLEANING SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(analysis_df), "\n")
cat("GHQ valid:", sum(! is.na(analysis_df$GHQ_score)), "\n")
cat("Age group valid:", sum(!is.na(analysis_df$age_group)), "\n")
cat("Sex valid:", sum(!is.na(analysis_df$sex)), "\n")
cat("Education valid:", sum(!is.na(analysis_df$education)), "\n")
cat("Financial status factor valid:", sum(!is.na(analysis_df$financial_status_f)), "\n")  # FIXED: Added check
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 2. WAVE NUMERIC CONVERSION
# ==============================================================================
analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    wave_char = as.character(wave),
    wave_numeric = case_when(
      wave_char == "b" ~ 2,
      wave_char == "e" ~ 5,
      wave_char == "g" ~ 7,
      wave_char == "i" ~ 9,
      wave_char == "k" ~ 11,
      wave_char == "m" ~ 13,
      wave_char == "n" ~ 14,
      wave_char == "o" ~ 15,
      TRUE ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(wave_char))
    ),
    wave_factor = as.factor(wave_numeric)
  )
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 3. CHECK ACTUAL DATA AVAILABILITY (Accounting for Negative = Missing)
# ==============================================================================

# Check GHQ availability (negative values = missing)
ghq_availability <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(GHQ_valid = if_else(GHQ_score >= 0, GHQ_score, NA_real_)) %>%
  group_by(wave_numeric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_ghq = sum(! is.na(GHQ_valid)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("GHQ Availability by Wave (excluding negatives):")
print(ghq_availability)

# Check social support availability
social_support_availability <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    friend_valid = if_else(positive_friend_ss >= 0, positive_friend_ss, NA_real_),
    family_valid = if_else(positive_family_ss >= 0, positive_family_ss, NA_real_),
    spouse_valid = if_else(positive_spouse_ss >= 0, positive_spouse_ss, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave_numeric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_friend = sum(!is.na(friend_valid)),
    n_family = sum(!is.na(family_valid)),
    n_spouse = sum(!is.na(spouse_valid)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("Social Support Availability by Wave (excluding negatives):")
print(social_support_availability)

# Check social strain availability
social_strain_availability <- analysis_df %>%
  group_by(wave_numeric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_friend_strain = sum(!is.na(negative_friend_ss)),
    n_family_strain = sum(!is.na(negative_family_ss)),
    n_spouse_strain = sum(!is.na(negative_spouse_ss)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("Social Strain Availability by Wave:")
print(social_strain_availability)

# Check lifestyle variables
lifestyle_availability <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    sleep_valid = if_else(sleep_hrs >= 0, sleep_hrs, NA_real_),
    fruit_valid = if_else(weekly_fruit >= 0, weekly_fruit, NA_real_),
    exercise_valid = if_else(weekly_v_exercised >= 0, weekly_v_exercised, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave_numeric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_sleep = sum(!is.na(sleep_valid)),
    n_fruit = sum(!is.na(fruit_valid)),
    n_exercise = sum(!is.na(exercise_valid)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("Lifestyle Variable Availability by Wave (excluding negatives):")
print(lifestyle_availability)

# FIXED: Add check for social support ceiling effects
cat("\n=== SOCIAL SUPPORT CEILING CHECK ===\n")
analysis_df %>%
  filter(! is.na(positive_friend_ss)) %>%
  summarise(
    friend_mean = mean(positive_friend_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    friend_median = median(positive_friend_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    friend_pct_at_max = mean(positive_friend_ss == 4, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    family_pct_at_max = mean(positive_family_ss == 4, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# DEMOGRAPHICS PANEL EDA
# ==============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# --- A. Age Group ---
p_age <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group) & ! is.na(GHQ_score)) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_ghq = mean(GHQ_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age_group, y = mean_ghq, fill = age_group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Age",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean GHQ-12"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 7.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 12), size = 12)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 17))

# --- B. Sex ---
p_sex <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(sex %in% c(1, 2) & !is.na(GHQ_score)) %>%
  mutate(sex_label = if_else(sex == 1, "Male", "Female")) %>%
  group_by(sex_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_ghq = mean(GHQ_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sex_label, y = mean_ghq, fill = sex_label)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "pink", "Male" = "lightblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Sex",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 17))

# --- C. Education ---
p_edu <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(education) & !is.na(GHQ_score)) %>%
  mutate(education = recode(education, "Other/None" = "None"))%>%
  group_by(education) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_ghq = mean(GHQ_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = education, y = mean_ghq, fill = education)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("None" = "#FC8D62", 
                                "Secondary" = "#8DA0CB", 
                                "Higher ed" = "#A6D854")) +
  labs(
    title = "Education",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 0.6, vjust = 1, size = 8)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 17))

# --- D.  Combine into Single Panel ---
demographics_panel <- p_age + p_sex + p_edu +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Mental Health Across Demographics",
    subtitle = "Average GHQ-12 scores by age, sex, and education level",
    caption = "Note: Higher GHQ-12 = worse mental health.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey50", hjust = 0)
    )
  )

# --- E. Display ---
demographics_panel + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1, 1.5))
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# FINANCIAL STATUS BY POOLED WAVE PERIODS (Years)
# ==============================================================================

# A.  Prepare data with pooled waves
financial_by_period <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(! is.na(financial_status) & financial_status > 0 & ! is.na(GHQ_score)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wave_numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Pool waves into periods (adjust years based on your actual wave years)
    wave_period = case_when(
      wave_numeric %in% c(2, 5) ~ "2010-2014",
      wave_numeric %in% c(7, 9) ~ "2015-2018",
      wave_numeric %in% c(11, 13) ~ "2019-2022",
      wave_numeric %in% c(14, 15) ~ "2023-2024",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(! is.na(wave_period)) %>%
  mutate(
    wave_period = factor(wave_period, levels = c("2010-2014", "2015-2018", "2019-2022", "2023-2024"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(financial_status, wave_period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ghq = mean(GHQ_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check the data

ggplot(financial_by_period, aes(x = factor(financial_status), y = mean_ghq, fill = wave_period)) +
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 4. MODEL 1: SOCIAL CONNECTIONS (Pooled 2-Year Gaps)
# ==============================================================================

ghq_cutoff <- 14

# A. First, clean negative values as NA
social_clean <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    GHQ_score = if_else(GHQ_score < 0, NA_real_, GHQ_score),
    positive_friend_ss = if_else(positive_friend_ss < 0, NA_real_, positive_friend_ss),
    positive_family_ss = if_else(positive_family_ss < 0, NA_real_, positive_family_ss),
    positive_spouse_ss = if_else(positive_spouse_ss < 0, NA_real_, positive_spouse_ss),
    negative_friend_ss = if_else(negative_friend_ss < 0, NA_real_, negative_friend_ss),
    negative_family_ss = if_else(negative_family_ss < 0, NA_real_, negative_family_ss),
    negative_spouse_ss = if_else(negative_spouse_ss < 0, NA_real_, negative_spouse_ss),
    sf12pcs = if_else(sf12pcs < 0, NA_real_, sf12pcs),
    financial_status = if_else(financial_status < 0, NA_real_, financial_status)
  )

# B. Create wide format to properly link baseline to follow-up

# Get baseline waves (W5 and W11)
baseline_waves <- social_clean %>%
  filter(wave_numeric %in% c(5, 11)) %>%
  select(pidp, wave_numeric, 
         GHQ_baseline = GHQ_score,
         positive_friend_ss, positive_family_ss, positive_spouse_ss,
         negative_friend_ss, negative_family_ss, negative_spouse_ss,
         sf12pcs, financial_status, financial_status_f, education,  # FIXED: Include factor
         live_w_partner, live_w_spouse,
         age_group, sex)

# Get outcome waves (W7 and W13)
outcome_waves <- social_clean %>%
  filter(wave_numeric %in% c(7, 13)) %>%
  select(pidp, 
         wave_outcome = wave_numeric,
         GHQ_outcome = GHQ_score)

# C. Join baseline to outcome (W5→W7, W11→W13)
social_df <- baseline_waves %>%
  mutate(
    wave_outcome_expected = case_when(
      wave_numeric == 5 ~ 7,
      wave_numeric == 11 ~ 13,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    outcome_waves,
    by = c("pidp", "wave_outcome_expected" = "wave_outcome")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GHQ_baseline) & GHQ_baseline >= ghq_cutoff) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GHQ_outcome)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(positive_friend_ss) & !is.na(positive_family_ss)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(negative_friend_ss) & !is.na(negative_family_ss)) %>%
  mutate(
    reliable_recovery = as.integer(
      (GHQ_baseline - GHQ_outcome) >= 4 & 
      GHQ_outcome < ghq_cutoff
    ),
    GHQ_score = GHQ_baseline,
    GHQ_next = GHQ_outcome
  )

# D. Check distribution across waves
print("Social Connections Model - Observations by Baseline Wave:")
social_df %>%
  group_by(wave_numeric) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_recovered = sum(reliable_recovery, na.rm = TRUE),
    recovery_rate = round(mean(reliable_recovery, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

print(paste("Total Social Model N:", nrow(social_df)))
print(paste("Overall Recovery Rate:", round(mean(social_df$reliable_recovery, na.rm = TRUE), 3)))
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 5. SOCIAL CONNECTIONS:  CENTERING & PARTNER LOGIC
# ==============================================================================

# A.  Partner Logic
social_df <- social_df %>%
  mutate(
    has_partner = if_else(live_w_partner == 1 | live_w_spouse == 1, 1, 0),
    has_partner = if_else(is.na(has_partner), 0, has_partner)
  )

# B. Partner Stats (for spouse support/strain - partnered people only)
partner_stats <- social_df %>%
  filter(has_partner == 1) %>%
  summarise(
    m_spouse_support = mean(positive_spouse_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_spouse_support = sd(positive_spouse_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    m_spouse_strain = mean(negative_spouse_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_spouse_strain = sd(negative_spouse_ss, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print("Partner Stats:")
print(partner_stats)

# C. Scale on FULL POOLED SAMPLE
social_df <- social_df %>%
  filter(sex %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  mutate(sex = droplevels(as.factor(sex))) %>%
  mutate(
    # Spouse SUPPORT (special handling for partnered only)
    spouse_c_temp = (positive_spouse_ss - partner_stats$m_spouse_support) / partner_stats$sd_spouse_support,
    spouse_c = case_when(
      has_partner == 0 ~ 0,
      has_partner == 1 & ! is.na(spouse_c_temp) ~ spouse_c_temp,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Spouse STRAIN (special handling for partnered only)
    spouse_strain_c_temp = (negative_spouse_ss - partner_stats$m_spouse_strain) / partner_stats$sd_spouse_strain,
    spouse_strain_c = case_when(
      has_partner == 0 ~ 0,
      has_partner == 1 & !is.na(spouse_strain_c_temp) ~ spouse_strain_c_temp,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Scale SUPPORT on POOLED sample
    GHQ_c = as.numeric(scale(GHQ_score)),
    family_c = as.numeric(scale(positive_family_ss)),
    friend_c = as.numeric(scale(positive_friend_ss)),
    
    # Scale STRAIN on POOLED sample
    family_strain_c = as.numeric(scale(negative_family_ss)),
    friend_strain_c = as.numeric(scale(negative_friend_ss)),
    
    # Scale controls
    sf12pcs_c = as.numeric(scale(sf12pcs)),
    # FIXED: Removed numeric scaling of financial_status
    # financial_status_c = as.numeric(scale(financial_status)),  # REMOVED
    
    # FIXED:  Ensure financial_status_f exists and has valid levels
    financial_status_f = factor(
      financial_status,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c("Living comfortably", "Doing alright", 
                 "Just getting by", "Finding it difficult", 
                 "Very difficult")
    ),
    
    # Factors
    has_partner_f = as.factor(has_partner),
    wave_factor = as.factor(wave_numeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    ! is.na(spouse_c) & !is.na(family_c) & !is.na(friend_c) &
    !is.na(spouse_strain_c) & !is.na(family_strain_c) & !is.na(friend_strain_c) &
    !is.na(sf12pcs_c) & !is.na(education) & !is.na(financial_status_f)  # FIXED: Check factor
  )

# D. Split into groups
social_df_partnered <- social_df %>% filter(has_partner == 1)
social_df_unpartnered <- social_df %>% filter(has_partner == 0)

print(paste("Partnered N:", nrow(social_df_partnered)))
print(paste("Unpartnered N:", nrow(social_df_unpartnered)))

# E. Check by wave within groups
print("Partnered by Wave:")
social_df_partnered %>% count(wave_numeric) %>% print()

print("Unpartnered by Wave:")
social_df_unpartnered %>% count(wave_numeric) %>% print()
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 6. SOCIAL CONNECTIONS: STRATIFIED MODELS (With Wave Control)
# ==============================================================================

# --- A.  PARTNERED MODEL ---
# FIXED: Changed financial_status_c to financial_status_f
partnered_model <- glmer(
  reliable_recovery ~ 
    GHQ_c + 
    # Social Support Block
    spouse_c + family_c + friend_c + 
    # Social Strain Block
    spouse_strain_c + family_strain_c + friend_strain_c +
    # Controls
    sf12pcs_c + financial_status_f + education +  # FIXED
    as.factor(age_group) + as.factor(sex) + 
    wave_factor +
    (1 | pidp), 
  data = social_df_partnered, 
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000))
)

print("=== PARTNERED MODEL ===")
summary(partnered_model)

# --- B. UNPARTNERED MODEL ---
# FIXED: Changed financial_status_c to financial_status_f
unpartnered_model <- glmer(
  reliable_recovery ~ 
    GHQ_c + 
    # Social Support Block (NO spouse_c)
    family_c + friend_c + 
    # Social Strain Block (NO spouse_strain_c)
    family_strain_c + friend_strain_c +
    # Controls
    sf12pcs_c + financial_status_f + education +  # FIXED
    as.factor(age_group) + as.factor(sex) + 
    wave_factor +
    (1 | pidp), 
  data = social_df_unpartnered, 
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000))
)

print("=== UNPARTNERED MODEL ===")
summary(unpartnered_model)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 7. SOCIAL CONNECTIONS: VISUALIZATION
# ==============================================================================

# A. Stats from FULL POOLED SAMPLE
full_sample_stats <- social_df %>%
  summarise(
    # Support
    spouse_support_mean = mean(positive_spouse_ss[has_partner == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    spouse_support_sd   = sd(positive_spouse_ss[has_partner == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    family_support_mean = mean(positive_family_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    family_support_sd   = sd(positive_family_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    friend_support_mean = mean(positive_friend_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    friend_support_sd   = sd(positive_friend_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Strain
    spouse_strain_mean = mean(negative_spouse_ss[has_partner == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    spouse_strain_sd   = sd(negative_spouse_ss[has_partner == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    family_strain_mean = mean(negative_family_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    family_strain_sd   = sd(negative_family_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    friend_strain_mean = mean(negative_friend_ss, na.rm = TRUE),
    friend_strain_sd   = sd(negative_friend_ss, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# B. Group-specific means for control variables
group_control_means <- social_df %>%
  group_by(has_partner) %>%
  summarise(
    sf12_z = mean(sf12pcs_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    ghq_z = mean(GHQ_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

partnered_controls <- group_control_means %>% filter(has_partner == 1)
unpartnered_controls <- group_control_means %>% filter(has_partner == 0)

# C. Reference persons (use modal wave for prediction)
modal_wave_partnered <- social_df_partnered %>% 
  count(wave_factor) %>% 
  slice_max(n) %>% 
  pull(wave_factor)

modal_wave_unpartnered <- social_df_unpartnered %>% 
  count(wave_factor) %>% 
  slice_max(n) %>% 
  pull(wave_factor)

# Use median/mode values
ref_partnered <- social_df_partnered %>%
  summarise(
    age_group = names(which.max(table(age_group))),
    sex = names(which.max(table(sex))),
    education = names(which.max(table(education))),
    pidp = first(pidp)
  )
ref_unpartnered <- social_df_unpartnered %>%
  summarise(
    age_group = names(which.max(table(age_group))),
    sex = names(which.max(table(sex))),
    education = names(which.max(table(education))),
    pidp = first(pidp)
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 7A. SOCIAL SUPPORT VISUALIZATION (Original Style)
# ==============================================================================

# D. Build Grid for PARTNERED (individual support types)
# FIXED: Changed financial_status_c to financial_status_f
viz_grid_partnered_support <- expand_grid(
  support_raw = seq(1, 4, length.out = 100),
  support_type = c("Friend support", "Family support", "Spouse support")
) %>%
  mutate(
    friend_c = case_when(
      support_type == "Friend support" ~ (support_raw - full_sample_stats$friend_support_mean) / full_sample_stats$friend_support_sd,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    family_c = case_when(
      support_type == "Family support" ~ (support_raw - full_sample_stats$family_support_mean) / full_sample_stats$family_support_sd,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    spouse_c = case_when(
      support_type == "Spouse support" ~ (support_raw - full_sample_stats$spouse_support_mean) / full_sample_stats$spouse_support_sd,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    friend_strain_c = 0,
    family_strain_c = 0,
    spouse_strain_c = 0,
    GHQ_c = partnered_controls$ghq_z,
    sf12pcs_c = partnered_controls$sf12_z,
    financial_status_f = "Doing alright",  # FIXED: Use factor level
    age_group = ref_partnered$age_group,
    sex = ref_partnered$sex,
    education = ref_partnered$education,
    wave_factor = modal_wave_partnered,
    pidp = ref_partnered$pidp,
    group = "Partnered"
  )

# E. Build Grid for UNPARTNERED (individual support types)
# FIXED: Changed financial_status_c to financial_status_f
viz_grid_unpartnered_support <- expand_grid(
  support_raw = seq(1, 4, length.out = 100),
  support_type = c("Friend support", "Family support")
) %>%
  mutate(
    friend_c = case_when(
      support_type == "Friend support" ~ (support_raw - full_sample_stats$friend_support_mean) / full_sample_stats$friend_support_sd,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    family_c = case_when(
      support_type == "Family support" ~ (support_raw - full_sample_stats$family_support_mean) / full_sample_stats$family_support_sd,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    friend_strain_c = 0,
    family_strain_c = 0,
    GHQ_c = unpartnered_controls$ghq_z,
    sf12pcs_c = unpartnered_controls$sf12_z,
    financial_status_f = "Doing alright",  # FIXED: Use factor level
    age_group = ref_unpartnered$age_group,
    sex = ref_unpartnered$sex,
    education = ref_unpartnered$education,
    wave_factor = modal_wave_unpartnered,
    pidp = ref_unpartnered$pidp,
    group = "Unpartnered"
  )

# F. Build Grid for TOTAL SUPPORT (all sources move together)
viz_grid_total_partnered_support <- tibble(
  support_raw = seq(1, 4, length.out = 100)
) %>%
  mutate(
    support_z = (support_raw - full_sample_stats$friend_support_mean) / full_sample_stats$friend_support_sd,
    friend_c = support_z,
    family_c = support_z,
    spouse_c = support_z,
    friend_strain_c = 0,
    family_strain_c = 0,
    spouse_strain_c = 0,
    GHQ_c = partnered_controls$ghq_z,
    sf12pcs_c = partnered_controls$sf12_z,
    financial_status_f = "Doing alright",  # FIXED
    age_group = ref_partnered$age_group,
    sex = ref_partnered$sex,
    education = ref_partnered$education,
    wave_factor = modal_wave_partnered,
    pidp = ref_partnered$pidp,
    group = "Partnered",
    support_type = "Total support"
  )

viz_grid_total_unpartnered_support <- tibble(
  support_raw = seq(1, 4, length.out = 100)
) %>%
  mutate(
    support_z = (support_raw - full_sample_stats$friend_support_mean) / full_sample_stats$friend_support_sd,
    friend_c = support_z,
    family_c = support_z,
    friend_strain_c = 0,
    family_strain_c = 0,
    GHQ_c = unpartnered_controls$ghq_z,
    sf12pcs_c = unpartnered_controls$sf12_z,
    financial_status_f = "Doing alright",  # FIXED
    age_group = ref_unpartnered$age_group,
    sex = ref_unpartnered$sex,
    education = ref_unpartnered$education,
    wave_factor = modal_wave_unpartnered,
    pidp = ref_unpartnered$pidp,
    group = "Unpartnered",
    support_type = "Total support"
  )

# G. Predict SUPPORT
viz_grid_partnered_support$pred_prob <- plogis(
  predict(partnered_model, newdata = viz_grid_partnered_support, re.form = NA)
)
viz_grid_unpartnered_support$pred_prob <- plogis(
  predict(unpartnered_model, newdata = viz_grid_unpartnered_support, re.form = NA)
)
viz_grid_total_partnered_support$pred_prob <- plogis(
  predict(partnered_model, newdata = viz_grid_total_partnered_support, re.form = NA)
)
viz_grid_total_unpartnered_support$pred_prob <- plogis(
  predict(unpartnered_model, newdata = viz_grid_total_unpartnered_support, re.form = NA)
)

# H. Combine SUPPORT grids
viz_grid_support_combined <- bind_rows(
  viz_grid_partnered_support,
  viz_grid_unpartnered_support,
  viz_grid_total_partnered_support,
  viz_grid_total_unpartnered_support
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Unpartnered", "Partnered")),
    support_type = factor(support_type, 
                          levels = c("Friend support", "Family support", "Spouse support", "Total support"))
  )

# I. Plot SUPPORT
ggplot(viz_grid_support_combined, aes(x = support_raw, y = pred_prob, color = support_type, linetype = support_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Friend support" = "#00BA38",
               "Family support" = "#F8766D",
               "Spouse support" = "#619CFF",
               "Total support" = "grey30")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Friend support" = "solid",
               "Family support" = "solid",
               "Spouse support" = "solid",
               "Total support" = "dashed")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +  # FIXED: Added percent format
  labs(
    title = "Social Support & Recovery by Relationship Status",
    subtitle = "Pooled 2-year transitions (W5→7 + W11→13) | Dashed = all sources moving together",
    x = "Support Score (1 = Low, 4 = High)",
    y = "Predicted Probability of Recovery",
    color = "Support Source",
    linetype = "Support Source",
    caption = "Note: Control variables set to group-specific means; wave effects controlled."  # FIXED: Added note
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1), linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
```
```{r}
# 8. MODEL 2: LIFESTYLE BEHAVIORS (Pooled 2-Year Gaps)
# ==============================================================================

# A. Clean negative values as NA
lifestyle_clean <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    GHQ_score = if_else(GHQ_score < 0, NA_real_, GHQ_score),
    sleep_hrs = if_else(sleep_hrs < 0, NA_real_, sleep_hrs),
    sleep_mins = if_else(sleep_mins < 0, NA_real_, sleep_mins),
    weekly_fruit = if_else(weekly_fruit < 0, NA_real_, weekly_fruit),
    weekly_veggies = if_else(weekly_veggies < 0, NA_real_, weekly_veggies),
    weekly_walked = if_else(weekly_walked < 0, NA_real_, weekly_walked),
    weekly_m_exercised = if_else(weekly_m_exercised < 0, NA_real_, weekly_m_exercised),
    weekly_v_exercised = if_else(weekly_v_exercised < 0, NA_real_, weekly_v_exercised),
    financial_status = if_else(financial_status < 0, NA_real_, financial_status),
    total_sleep_hours = sleep_hrs + (sleep_mins / 60),
    
    # FIXED: Recode diet variables early
    fruit_days = case_when(
      weekly_fruit == 1 ~ 0,
      weekly_fruit == 2 ~ 2,
      weekly_fruit == 3 ~ 5,
      weekly_fruit == 4 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    veg_days = case_when(
      weekly_veggies == 1 ~ 0,
      weekly_veggies == 2 ~ 2,
      weekly_veggies == 3 ~ 5,
      weekly_veggies == 4 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# B. Get baseline waves (W7 and W13)
baseline_lifestyle <- lifestyle_clean %>%
  filter(wave_numeric %in% c(7, 13)) %>%
  select(pidp, wave_numeric,
         GHQ_baseline = GHQ_score,
         total_sleep_hours, 
         fruit_days, veg_days,  # FIXED: Use recoded variables
         weekly_walked, weekly_m_exercised, weekly_v_exercised,
         financial_status, financial_status_f, education,
         live_w_partner, live_w_spouse,
         age_group, sex)

# C. Get outcome waves (W9 and W15) - unchanged
outcome_lifestyle <- lifestyle_clean %>%
  filter(wave_numeric %in% c(9, 15)) %>%
  select(pidp,
         wave_outcome = wave_numeric,
         GHQ_outcome = GHQ_score)

# D. Join baseline to outcome - unchanged except variable names
model2_df <- baseline_lifestyle %>%
  mutate(
    wave_outcome_expected = case_when(
      wave_numeric == 7 ~ 9,
      wave_numeric == 13 ~ 15,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    outcome_lifestyle,
    by = c("pidp", "wave_outcome_expected" = "wave_outcome")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GHQ_baseline) & GHQ_baseline >= ghq_cutoff) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GHQ_outcome)) %>%
  mutate(
    reliable_recovery = as.integer(
      (GHQ_baseline - GHQ_outcome) >= 4 & 
      GHQ_outcome < ghq_cutoff
    ),
    GHQ_score = GHQ_baseline,
    GHQ_next = GHQ_outcome,
    has_partner = if_else(live_w_partner == 1 | live_w_spouse == 1, 1, 0),
    has_partner = if_else(is.na(has_partner), 0, has_partner),
    wave_factor = as.factor(wave_numeric)
  )
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 9. LIFESTYLE:  CENTERING & FINAL SAMPLE
# ==============================================================================

model2_df <- model2_df %>%
  filter(sex %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  mutate(sex = droplevels(as.factor(sex))) %>%
  mutate(
    # Scale on POOLED sample
    sleep_c = as.numeric(scale(total_sleep_hours)),
    
    # FIXED: Scale the recoded fruit/veg days (not the 1-4 codes)
    fruit_c = as.numeric(scale(fruit_days)),
    veg_c = as.numeric(scale(veg_days)),
    
    # Exercise (unchanged)
    walk_c = as.numeric(scale(weekly_walked)),
    mod_ex_c = as.numeric(scale(weekly_m_exercised)),
    vig_ex_c = as.numeric(scale(weekly_v_exercised)),
    
    # Other (unchanged)
    GHQ_c = as.numeric(scale(GHQ_score)),
    financial_status_f = factor(
      financial_status,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c("Living comfortably", "Doing alright", 
                 "Just getting by", "Finding it difficult", 
                 "Very difficult")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    ! is.na(sleep_c) & !is.na(fruit_c) & !is.na(veg_c) &
    !is.na(vig_ex_c) & !is.na(financial_status_f) & !is.na(education)
  )

print(paste("Final Lifestyle Sample N:", nrow(model2_df)))

# Verify
cat("\n=== DIET VARIABLE CHECK (After Recoding) ===\n")
cat("Fruit days - Mean:", round(mean(model2_df$fruit_days, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
    "SD:", round(sd(model2_df$fruit_days, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("Veg days - Mean:", round(mean(model2_df$veg_days, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
    "SD:", round(sd(model2_df$veg_days, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 10. LIFESTYLE MODEL (With Wave Control)
# ==============================================================================

# FIXED: Changed financial_status_c to financial_status_f
lifestyle_model <- glmer(
  reliable_recovery ~ 
    GHQ_c + 
    # Lifestyle Predictors
    ns(sleep_c, df = 2) +
    fruit_c + veg_c + 
    walk_c + mod_ex_c + vig_ex_c + 
    # Controls
    education +
    financial_status_f +  # FIXED
    as.factor(has_partner) +
    as.factor(age_group) + as.factor(sex) + 
    wave_factor +
    (1 | pidp), 
  data = model2_df, 
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000))
)

print("=== LIFESTYLE MODEL ===")
summary(lifestyle_model)
```

```{r}
print(lifestyle_stats)

# B. Get modal wave for prediction
modal_wave_lifestyle <- model2_df %>%

  pull(wave_factor)

# C. Build prediction grid
# FIXED: Changed financial_status_c to financial_status_f
lifestyle_viz_grid <- expand_grid(
  z_score = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100),
  predictor = c("Sleep Duration", "Vegetable Intake", "Walking")
) %>%
  mutate(
    sleep_c = if_else(predictor == "Sleep Duration", z_score, 0),
    veg_c = if_else(predictor == "Vegetable Intake", z_score, 0),
    walk_c = if_else(predictor == "Walking", z_score, 0),
    fruit_c = 0, 
    vig_ex_c = 0,
    mod_ex_c = 0, 
    education = "Secondary",
    financial_status_f = "Doing alright",  # FIXED
    GHQ_c = 0, 
    has_partner = 1,
    age_group = model2_df$age_group[1],
    sex = model2_df$sex[1],
    wave_factor = modal_wave_lifestyle,
    pidp = model2_df$pidp[1]
  )

lifestyle_viz_grid$pred_prob <- plogis(
```

```{r}
# B. Build prediction grid in DAYS (0-7 scale)

) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert days to z-scores for each exercise type
    walk_c = if_else(exercise_type == "Walking", 
                     (days_per_week - exercise_stats$walk_m) / exercise_stats$walk_sd, 
                     0),
    mod_ex_c = if_else(exercise_type == "Moderate Exercise", 
                       (days_per_week - exercise_stats$mod_m) / exercise_stats$mod_sd,

                       (days_per_week - exercise_stats$vig_m) / exercise_stats$vig_sd, 
                       0),
    
    # Hold everything else constant at mean
    sleep_c = 0,
    fruit_c = 0,
    veg_c = 0,
    education = "Secondary",
    financial_status_f = "Doing alright",
    GHQ_c = 0,
    has_partner = 1,
    age_group = model2_df$age_group[1],
    sex = model2_df$sex[1],
    wave_factor = modal_wave_lifestyle,
    pidp = model2_df$pidp[1]

)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 14. MODEL COMPARISON:  SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

# A. Compare pooled vs single-wave for lifestyle (if enough data)
if(sum(model2_df$wave_numeric == 13) > 100) {
  
  lifestyle_single <- model2_df %>% filter(wave_numeric == 13)
  
  # FIXED: Changed financial_status_c to financial_status_f
  lifestyle_model_single <- glmer(
    reliable_recovery ~ 
      GHQ_c + 
      ns(sleep_c, df = 2) + fruit_c + veg_c + 
      walk_c + mod_ex_c + vig_ex_c + 
      education + financial_status_f +  # FIXED
      as.factor(has_partner) +
      as.factor(age_group) + as.factor(sex) + 
      (1 | pidp), 
    data = lifestyle_single, 
    family = binomial,
    control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
  )
  
  # Compare key coefficients
  comparison <- bind_rows(
    tidy(lifestyle_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Pooled (W7+W13)"),
    tidy(lifestyle_model_single, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Single (W13 only)")
  ) %>%
    filter(term %in% c("fruit_c", "veg_c", "vig_ex_c", "walk_c")) %>%  # FIXED: Added walk_c
    select(model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value)
  
  print("=== SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS:  Pooled vs Single Wave ===")
  print(comparison)
}
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 15. SUMMARY TABLE:  BOTH MODELS
# ==============================================================================

# A. Extract coefficients from all models
social_partnered_coef <- tidy(partnered_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(model = "Social - Partnered")

social_unpartnered_coef <- tidy(unpartnered_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(model = "Social - Unpartnered")

lifestyle_coef <- tidy(lifestyle_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(model = "Lifestyle")

# B.  Combine and format
all_coefs <- bind_rows(
  social_partnered_coef,
  social_unpartnered_coef,
  lifestyle_coef
) %>%
  filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
  filter(! grepl("Intercept|age_group|sex|wave_factor", term)) %>%
  select(model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    std.error = round(std.error, 3),
    p.value = round(p.value, 4),
    significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      p.value < 0.10 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

print("=== SUMMARY:  ALL MODEL COEFFICIENTS ===")
print(all_coefs, n = 50)

# C. Model fit statistics
model_fit <- tibble(
  Model = c("Social - Partnered", "Social - Unpartnered", "Lifestyle"),
  N = c(nrow(social_df_partnered), nrow(social_df_unpartnered), nrow(model2_df)),
  Recovery_Rate = c(
    mean(social_df_partnered$reliable_recovery, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(social_df_unpartnered$reliable_recovery, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(model2_df$reliable_recovery, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  AIC = c(AIC(partnered_model), AIC(unpartnered_model), AIC(lifestyle_model)),
  Waves_Pooled = c("W5→7 + W11→13", "W5→7 + W11→13", "W7→9 + W13→15"),
  Gap = c("2 years", "2 years", "2 years")
) %>%
  mutate(Recovery_Rate = round(Recovery_Rate, 3))

print("=== MODEL FIT SUMMARY ===")
print(model_fit)
```
